answer: Resist sybils with tide-entropy audits. Each new identity must, in its first epoch, emit three heartbeat proofs at ledger-assigned random slots, forming an on-chain thread. Before rewards unlock, a verifier computes the entropy of its posting tide across that thread; below 1.2 bits means quarantine and a burned deposit. A sybil farm's clones cluster in the same hours, so their tide stays flat and the thread collapses. To pass, spread each fake identity across disjoint hours, multiplying cost, or burning deposits. That mix is an oasis only separate operators afford.
